events.address: Yoseka Land, 58 West St, Brooklyn, NY 11222
events.what_it_is: The New York stop of TRAVELER’S COMPANY's 20th Anniversary Caravan, with an anniversary gallery, Stamp Caravan and limited/event-exclusive notebook merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the Sept. 18–20 public pop-up, anniversary gallery and Stamp Caravan is free. Merchandise is sold separately.
events.caveats: The earlier Sept. 11–12 workshop/timed-entry portion was ticketed and sold out. The official rolling update explicitly directs visitors to the Sept. 18–20 free-admission days. Limited anniversary items may sell out.
events.practical_notes: Free-admission public days run Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–7 PM at Yoseka Land. No advance reservation requirement is published for these free-admission days.

events.what_it_is: A free community wellness and resource day with healthcare and mental-health resources, housing and food assistance, employment and education resources, legal services, holistic wellness organizations and family activities.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the advertised community-resource programming are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: The published listing says the event is free and open to residents from Queens and all five boroughs and provides an RSVP link. No organizer-selection or approval step is stated.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–2 PM. Playground entrance at 42nd Ave. and 104th St.

events.address: CUE Art Foundation, 137 W 25th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Climate Week kickoff pop-up selection of artist books curated by Interspecies Library founder Oscar Salguero, followed by a presentation and happy hour.
events.what_is_free: The host lists an RSVP for the book browsing, presentation and happy-hour program; no ticket price is stated on the current host listing.
events.caveats: CUE's current event calendar provides an RSVP action but does not describe organizer approval or door-discretion language in the indexed listing.
events.practical_notes: Book browsing is 12–5 PM; presentation and happy hour are 5–6 PM.
